svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut to 1,142 with a fine abrasive disc; seal the ends with thin epoxy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the motor centres 1,062 apart, 40 from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the pylon centre half way between the motors; this is the balance point.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 6 hole on the underside 150 inboard of each motor for the motor wires.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wrap the clamp areas with one turn of glass tape to spread the clamp load.
